prompt: Nine round cream clay medallion tiles in a 3x3 grid, all the same size, evenly spaced, not touching. Each tile has one simple raised motif in muted pastels: a plump floor cushion; a feather on a folded blanket; a small cloud with a curl of breeze; a rolled yoga mat; a steaming cup of tea; three stacked smooth pebbles; a soft heart with two small leaves; a glowing lantern; a little brass bell. No text, no people. Solid flat pure bright green #00FF00 background. Cosy Animal Crossing New Horizons inspired soft 3D clay, rounded chunky shapes, smooth matte clay materials, gentle warm lighting, pastel pink, cream, sage and honey wood.
